source: Optidrive ODE-3 (E3) IP20 User Guide, Rev 1.05 (82-E3I20-IN), firmware 3.11
code_to_addr_convention: P-XX -> (groupNum=1, paramNum=XX); P00-XX -> (groupNum=0, paramNum=XX). Confirmar con .ptb E3 real cuando esté disponible. Supporting evidence: the IP20 guide (Section 8.4, p.33) defines the Modbus holding register for P-04..P-60 as 128 + parameter number, i.e. the drive addresses settable parameters by a flat parameter number with no group offset.
scaling_note: The .ptb <decimal> field is always 0, so display scaling is not recoverable from the file. Scale factors here come from the documented Modbus scaling of the same quantities (Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide, Section 8.4, p.33): frequency x10 ('Setpoint frequency x10, e.g. 100 = 10.0Hz'), ramp time x100 ('Ramp time in seconds x 100, e.g. 250 = 2.5 seconds'), current x10 ('Output Motor Current in Amps x10'), percentage x10, voltage x1, temperature x1, speed (RPM) x1.
range_note: min_display / max_display are advisory only. modify_ptb_configuration validates ranges against the <min> / <max> elements of the .ptb itself, because those are the truth for the specific firmware/frame size. These registry bounds are used only as a fallback for LParam elements, which carry no <min>/<max> in the file. null = not documented in the knowledge base; do not invent a bound.

provenance_legend.kb: Parameter number, role and/or name are documented in agent/data/ (the curated E3 knowledge base). Cited per entry.
provenance_legend.inferred: Parameter number is NOT documented in the current knowledge base. Taken from the standard Optidrive E3 parameter layout and consistent with neighbouring kb-documented entries. MUST be confirmed against the full parameter table (see todo.missing_source) or a real E3 .ptb before being trusted for a write.

P-01.name: Maximum Frequency / Speed Limit
P-01.provenance_note: Section 1.4 Quick Start, p.6: 'vary the speed from P-02 (0Hz default) to P-01 (50 / 60 Hz default)'. Default documented, range not.

P-02.name: Minimum Frequency / Speed Limit
P-02.provenance_note: Section 1.4 Quick Start, p.6 (0 Hz default).

P-03.name: Acceleration Ramp Time
P-03.provenance_note: Not named in the knowledge base. Inferred as the acceleration counterpart of P-04, which the KB does document as 'Decel Ramp 1' (Section 8.4, p.33). Scale from the documented ramp-time scaling (x100).

P-04.name: Deceleration Ramp Time
P-04.provenance_note: Section 8.4, p.33, Control Word Bit 1: 'Low = Decel Ramp 1 (P-04), High = Decel Ramp 2 (P-24)'.

P-07.name: Motor Rated Voltage
P-07.provenance_note: Not named in the knowledge base. Inferred as part of the P-07..P-10 motor nameplate block, whose P-08 (rated current) and P-10 (rated speed) members ARE documented.

P-08.name: Motor Rated Current
P-08.provenance_note: Section 4.8.1 (motor thermal overload: 'delivering >100% of the value set in P-08'); Section 8.4.2, p.34, Status Word Bit 8 ('set if motor current > P-08'); Section 5.7, p.17 (overload display).

P-09.name: Motor Rated Frequency
P-09.provenance_note: Not named in the knowledge base. Inferred as part of the P-07..P-10 motor nameplate block.

P-10.name: Motor Rated Speed
P-10.provenance_note: Section 6 keypad displays: 'If P-10 > 0, pressing the Navigate key for < 1 second will display the motor speed (RPM)'.

P-11.name: Torque Boost / V-F Characteristic Boost
P-11.provenance_note: Not documented in the knowledge base at all (neither number nor name nor units). Included because boost is a common troubleshooting lever; treat as UNVERIFIED.

P-12.name: Primary Command Source
P-12.provenance_note: Section 7, pp.27-31: P-12 = 0 Terminal Mode; 1 or 2 Keypad Mode; 3, 4, 7, 8 or 9 Fieldbus Control Mode (3 or 4 = Modbus network control); 5 or 6 User PI Control Mode. Range 0..9 derived from that enumeration.

P-15.name: Digital Input Function Select (Macro)
P-15.provenance_note: Section 7.4, p.29 macro table (settings 0..17 transcribed) plus the p.29 note 'When P-15 = 19, P-30 Index 2 and Index 3 have no effect'. Fire Mode requires P-15 = 15, 16 or 17.

P-16.name: Analog Input 1 Format
P-16.provenance_note: Section 9.4 I/O: 'Format selected by P-16 (Analog Input 1)'; Section 7.1: analog input 1 format. Setting values not transcribed in the KB.

P-18.name: Relay Output Function Select
P-18.provenance_note: Section 9.4: 'Relay Output: configured by P-18'; Fire Mode doc: 'P-18 setting 10 ... Fire Mode Active output signal' (pp.20-21).

P-20.name: Preset Speed 1
P-20.provenance_note: Section 7.4, p.29: 'PR-REF = Preset speeds P-20 - P-23 used for speed reference'. Also the INC SPD / DEC SPD step size.

P-21.name: Preset Speed 2
P-21.provenance_note: Section 7.4, p.29 preset speed selection table (DI combinations 00->P-20, 10->P-21, 01->P-22, 11->P-23).

P-22.name: Preset Speed 3
P-22.provenance_note: Section 7.4, p.29 preset speed selection table.

P-23.name: Preset Speed 4
P-23.provenance_note: Section 7.4, p.29; also 'Speed reference in Fire Mode is always Preset Speed 4, P-23'.

P-24.name: Fast Stop Ramp Time
P-24.provenance_note: Section 7.4, p.29 (verbatim): 'FAST STOP (P-24) ... Open momentarily to FAST STOP the drive using Fast Stop Ramp Time P-24'. Doubles as Decel Ramp 2 (Section 8.4, p.33).

P-25.name: Analog Output Function Select
P-25.provenance_note: Section 9.4: 'Analog Output: configured by P-25'; Fire Mode doc references 'P-25 relay-digital settings' for a Fire Mode Active signal.

P-30.name: Start Mode / Auto-Restart
P-30.provenance_note: p.21. INDEXED: Index 1 = start mode / automatic restart (AUto-1..AUto-5), Index 2 = Fire Mode input polarity, Index 3 = Fire Mode input momentary/maintained. Indexed parameters are refused by modify_ptb_configuration.

P-34.name: Brake Chopper Enable (Not Size 1)
P-34.provenance_note: Brake resistor doc (verbatim parameter name): 'Parameter P-34, "Brake Chopper Enable (Not Size 1)", enables the chopper'. Frame Size 2 and above only.

P-36.name: Serial Communications Configuration (Modbus RTU)
P-36.provenance_note: Section 8, p.35. INDEXED and mixed-type: Index 1 = drive address (0-63, default 1), Index 2 = baud rate (default 115.2 kbps), Index 3 = comms-loss watchdog timeout (default 't 3000' ms). Refused by modify_ptb_configuration; the 't'/'r' suffix of Index 3 is not a plain integer.

P-47.name: Analog Input 2 Format
P-47.provenance_note: p.24. Setting 'Ptc-th' selects motor thermistor measurement (trip 2.5k ohm, reset 2k ohm), valid with any P-15 setting that has Input 3 as E-Trip. Numeric value of each setting is not transcribed in the KB.

P-54.name: Motor Current Limit
P-54.provenance_note: Section 4.8.1: 'internal motor overload protection / current limit set at 150% of FLA. This may be adjusted in parameter P-54.' Units documented as % of FLA; the x10 scale is assumed from the general percentage scaling and is UNVERIFIED for this parameter.

P-60.name: Motor Overload Management
P-60.provenance_note: Motor thermistor doc (verbatim name) + UL doc: 'Thermal Overload Memory Retention must be enabled by setting P-60 Index 1 = 1'. INDEXED: Index 1 = thermal overload memory retention, plus the current-limit reaction (trip vs reduction). Refused by modify_ptb_configuration.

P-63.name: Modbus Mode (Standard / Advanced)
P-63.provenance_note: Modbus doc: 'P-63 selects Standard or Advanced Modbus mode.'

P00-01.name: Analog Input 1 Value
P00-01.provenance_note: READ-ONLY status parameter. Section 8.4, p.33, register 20: '0..1000, % of full scale x10'.

P00-02.name: Analog Input 2 Value
P00-02.provenance_note: READ-ONLY status parameter. Section 8.4, p.33, register 21.

P00-03.name: Speed Reference Value
P00-03.provenance_note: READ-ONLY status parameter. Section 8.4, p.33, register 22: '0..1000, setpoint frequency x10'.

P00-08.name: DC Bus Voltage
P00-08.provenance_note: READ-ONLY status parameter. Section 8.4, p.33, register 23: '0..1000 V'.

P00-09.name: Drive Temperature
P00-09.provenance_note: READ-ONLY status parameter. Section 8.4, p.33, register 24: '0..100 degC'.

P00-13.name: Trip Log
P00-13.provenance_note: READ-ONLY status parameter and INDEXED (fault history). Doubly refused by modify_ptb_configuration.
